Population decreased in Enfield

The estimated population of Enfield in 2024 was 327,434 usual residents, a fall of 0.2% since 2023.

This meant that Enfield was among one of only eleven local authorities in England and Wales where the population got smaller.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Enfield decreased by 0.7%.

Over this slightly longer period, Enfield was among one of only five local authorities in England and Wales where the population got smaller.

Age profile of Enfield

The average (median) age rose to 38.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Enfield has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Enfield is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Enfield's population of 327,434 usual residents was made up of:

  • 70,418 people aged 0 to 15 years, (21.5%)
  • 208,979 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.8%)
  • 48,037 people aged 65 years and over, (14.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Enfield has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (14.7% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Enfield, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Enfield
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Enfield, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 1,608 people (0.5%). In total, there were 3,709 births and 2,101 deaths in Enfield.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 3,839 (-1.2%). There were 22,287 people entering the area and 26,126 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Enfield's population of 1,644 (0.5%) as a result of 5,512 people entering the area and 3,868 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Enfield was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Enfield in mid-2023 is 328,014.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 739 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 154 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 585 people.
